decisions.reason: The quantified customer saving of more than €600,000 per year indicates performance clearly above aspiration for a core-adjacent innovation, so management would continue it.
As a close-to-core machine with its own product page and no sign of underperformance, it is likely to be given more time in a growing firm with enough slack and long industrial sales cycles.

Although evidence is still limited, it builds on the established offer and in a hiring, investing firm behavioral decision makers would usually tolerate this early uncertainty rather than drop it immediately.

This trommel screen is near the firm's existing business, and absent clear results below aspiration the firm would typically retain it for another period while using available slack to learn from the market.
